headline: Mercedes is fined €5,000 after Russell skips post-race media
body: George Russell did not attend the media pen after the Mexican Grand Prix and was summoned to the stewards, who fined Mercedes €5,000. Toto Wolff says Russell was distraught after an energy deployment problem at the start sent him back from the front row, and that his absence was understandable.

headline: Cadillac will investigate the failure behind Bottas's crash
body: Team principal Marcin Budkowski says Cadillac will fully investigate the front-left suspension failure that put Valtteri Bottas into the barrier at Turn 1, and make sure such accidents do not happen again. Bottas was given the all-clear after a trip to the medical centre.
